C-R8-PROTOCOL-PROFILE-326.IntentSummary: Add a narrowly scoped protocol-profile extension after deterministic base processing, keeping machine provenance and manual corrections separate while reusing existing document templates and reprocess history.

T-001.Title: kafedra-feature: add deterministic protocol profile extension

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Only active department_protocol templates are considered and the base parser remains sufficient without them.
Explicit aliases map profile fields to canonical meeting properties only when the base parser left those properties empty.
Unknown profile fields remain evidence-backed machine fields and do not become confirmed domain properties automatically.
A bad profile is isolated from the successful base protocol and other matching profiles.

T-002.Title: kafedra-data: preserve provenance and manual correction history

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Materialized profile fields append documentVersionId, extractionRunId, template identity and locator to meeting evidence without changing immutable source.
Reprocess writes a new extraction run and never rewrites an older run.
A conflicting existing working value remains unchanged and produces review-by-exception with incoming machine evidence.

T-003.Title: kafedra-tests: prove two synthetic same-format documents, correction and partial failure

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Both synthetic fixtures use one profile and produce distinct protocol numbers with exact source locators.
Manual correction plus same-version reprocess preserves the working value and both machine runs.
A malformed sibling profile creates review but does not mark the base protocol failed.
Documentation and tests explicitly label the fixtures synthetic and leave real two-document acceptance pending.

T-004.Title: kafedra-data audit: verify no schema or evidence regression

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: No migration, blob mutation, document_version replacement, ACL change or LLM dependency is introduced.
GRACE scope and project CI prove the worker/database changes on the exact PR head.
